active_pbis.title: [DISC-002] Multi-Process Feasibility Engine & Pluggable Manufacturing Strategy Architecture

specification.user_story: As a Lead Applications Engineer, I want the feasibility engine to evaluate multi-process manufacturing strategies (CNC 3-axis, 5-axis, sheet metal stamping, wire EDM, investment casting) via pluggable heuristics so that complex hardware designs receive optimized fabrication routes across registered Nigerian clusters.
specification.input: PrismReportManifest BRep geometry, tolerance classes ISO 2768-m/f, material specification (e.g. 6061-T6 aluminum, 4140 chromoly steel), quantity bracket (10-100 units).
specification.action: Execute Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) process routing engine; match bounding envelopes and tooling constraints against nationwide cluster capacity; compute multi-process cost bracket and lead-time confidence score.
specification.output: MultiProcessFeasibilityReport JSON with ranked manufacturing strategies, cost breakdown in NGN, cycle time in business days, and cluster workshop routing targets.

active_pbis.acceptance_criteria_gherkin:
Given an intake RFQ for 50 CNC-milled sensor enclosures with thin walls (1.8 mm) and M4 tapped holes
When the multi-process feasibility engine executes the pluggable strategy routing pipeline
Then it decomposes operations into rough milling (3-axis), finishing, and single-point tapping
And calculates an estimated unit cost of ₦16,200 ± 8% with 6-day lead time
And routes the job to 3 qualified shops in the Ikeja/Ilupeju cluster with active spindle capacity.
technical_subtasks: ST-DISC-01: Create pluggable manufacturing strategy heuristic modules under src/dfn_discovery/strategies/.
ST-DISC-02: Implement DAG process sequencing engine accepting PrismReportManifest v1.1 BRep geometry.
ST-DISC-03: Connect routing engine with cluster workshop database evaluating machine bed limits, spindle power, and generator ratings.
ST-DISC-04: Implement first-article tolerance verification state machine for KAN-38.
ST-DISC-05: Build pyrometer thermal soak telemetry analyzer for KAN-41.
ST-DISC-06: Run 6-point quality gate and submit DoD PR.

active_pbis.title: [SUB-08] Procedural Tooling, Modular Clamps & Enclosure Parametrics

specification.user_story: As a Tooling Engineer, I want parametric generators for modular soft jaws, clamp strap assemblies, and sheet metal enclosures so that low-volume CNC fixture setups and bend allowances are generated deterministically without manual CAD drafting.
specification.input: Part envelope dimensions (L x W x H mm), clamping force requirement (kN), machine T-slot table pitch (14mm / 18mm DIN 650), sheet thickness and material grade.
specification.action: Execute algorithmic BRep geometry synthesizer; calculate DIN 6935 bend deduction and clamp bolt torque ratings; export standardized DXF flat-patterns and STEP fixture models.
specification.output: ParametricToolingManifest with generated fixture geometry, BOM line items, and machine setup traveler instructions.

active_pbis.acceptance_criteria_gherkin:
Given a rectangular 6061-T6 workpiece (150 x 80 x 25 mm) requiring 4-axis second-operation facing
When the parametric tooling generator executes with 14mm T-slot table parameters

And outputs compliant fixture STEP geometry and bolt torque specifications (45 N·m)

active_pbis.title: [PRISM-004] 3D CAD Interpreter, DFM Anomaly Detection & BOP/BOM Engine

specification.user_story: As an Applications Engineer, I want the system to parse STEP/IGES/STL CAD geometry, evaluate DIN ISO 2768 tolerances, and flag deep pockets and tool collisions before metal is cut.
specification.input: Binary or text STEP (AP203/AP214/AP242) or binary STL/IGES CAD model.
specification.action: Execute OpenCASCADE BRep topological traversal; extract bounding box, surface area, volume, and wall thicknesses; compute DIN ISO 2768-1/2 tolerance bounds; run heuristic anomaly detectors for deep pockets (>4:1 aspect ratio), zero-radius internal corners, and tool reach interference.
specification.output: PrismReportManifest v1.1 containing feature topology graph, bounding dimensions, DFM violation list with severity (Warning/Error), raw stock envelope, and Bill of Process (BOP) sequence.

active_pbis.acceptance_criteria_gherkin:
Given a STEP AP214 file of an aluminum mounting bracket with 3.0 mm walls and an internal pocket of depth 45 mm and width 8 mm (aspect ratio 5.6:1)
When the OpenCASCADE BRep interpreter executes geometric extraction
Then it flags a DFM anomaly 'TOOLING_ASPECT_RATIO_EXCEEDED: Pocket depth 45mm requires >4:1 reach endmill'
And evaluates DIN ISO 2768-m linear tolerances for all extracted features
And generates signed HMAC-SHA256 PrismReportManifest v1.1 payload.
technical_subtasks: ST-CAD-01: Enhance OpenCASCADE BRep topological traversal in src/dfn_prism/geometry/brep_analyzer.py for STEP AP214 and IGES CAD files.
ST-CAD-02: Implement heuristic anomaly detectors for deep internal pockets (>4:1 aspect ratio) and R0 corners.
ST-CAD-03: Integrate DIN ISO 2768-1/2 tolerance engine directly into PrismReportManifest v1.1.
ST-CAD-04: Build fatigue stress evaluator (src/dfn_prism/stress/fatigue_evaluator.py) for KAN-34.
ST-CAD-05: Run PyTest suite in .venv with zero regressions across 44 tests.
ST-CAD-06: Run 6-point quality gate and submit DoD PR.

evening_dispatched_pbis.title: [US-C-01] First-Article Tolerance Verification Gate

specification.user_story: As a Quality Inspector / Machinist (Sunday), I want to record first-article dimensional readings and micrometer photos so that the platform authorizes full batch production only after dimensional compliance is verified.
specification.input: First-article telemetry: nominal dimension, lower/upper tolerance limits (40.000 mm to 40.012 mm), three sequential micrometer readings, tool serial ID, and timestamped verification photograph.
specification.action: Compute dimensional deviation, circular taper (|max - min|), and tolerance band containment; compare taper against maximum permissible threshold (0.003 mm); evaluate pass/fail criteria.
specification.output: FirstArticleAuthorization state object: status ('ACCEPTED' | 'REJECTED'), authorization token to run batch, immutable audit log entry in job traveler.

evening_dispatched_pbis.acceptance_criteria_gherkin:
Given an order for 30 motor shafts with bearing journal tolerance 40.000 mm to 40.012 mm
When Sunday enters first-article readings of 40.008 mm, 40.007 mm, and 40.009 mm with a micrometer photo
Then the platform calculates a taper of 0.002 mm (within 0.003 mm limit)
And displays: 'FIRST ARTICLE ACCEPTED: AUTHORIZED TO RUN BATCH (29 UNITS REMAINING)'
And logs the timestamped inspection record to the job audit trail.

evening_dispatched_pbis.title: [US-B-03] Hub Optical Emission Spectrometry (OES) Scrap Interception (Negative / Exception)

specification.user_story: As a Hub Metallurgical Technician, I want to input raw billet OES spark emission spectrometer readings so that counterfeit or off-spec scrap alloys are intercepted before reaching CNC machine spindles.
specification.input: Material lot intake payload: claimed alloy grade (e.g. AISI 4340), supplier ID, raw stock heat number, percentage chemical composition readings (%C, %Mn, %Si, %Cr, %Ni, %Mo, %S, %P).
specification.action: Query ASTM/ISO material chemistry envelope; compare spark scan readouts against elemental composition bounds (ASTM A29 specifies Cr: 0.70-0.90%, Ni: 1.65-2.00%); flag discrepancies.
specification.output: MaterialInspectionResult with interception status ('PASSED' | 'DISCREPANCY_INTERCEPTED'), dispatch lockout flag, automated debit note against supplier account, customer escrow refund trigger.

evening_dispatched_pbis.acceptance_criteria_gherkin:
Given a delivery of purported AISI 4340 alloy bar stock
When the technician enters OES spark scan readings showing Chromium at 0.38% and Nickel at 0.11%
Then the platform flags an 'Alloy Composition Discrepancy (Failed ASTM A29)'
And locks dispatch to the CNC machine shop
And issues a debit note against the supplier's platform account
And refunds the customer's material escrow line.

evening_dispatched_pbis.acceptance_criteria_gherkin:

evening_dispatched_pbis.title: [US-C-03] Substrate-Verified Finishing Process Traveler

specification.user_story: As a Surface Finishing Specialist (Chukwudi), I want to access a digital process traveler displaying verified substrate chemistry and process parameters so that electrolyte baths are protected from contamination and anodized parts achieve certified coating thickness.
specification.input: Batch routing traveler: batch ID, component count (35 units), process type (black sulfuric anodizing), substrate alloy lot cert (6061-T6, Si < 0.4%).
specification.action: Validate substrate alloy compatibility with chemical bath; compute tank temperature (18°C), current density (1.5 A/dm²), and immersion duration (45 min); enforce pre-shipment eddy-current coating thickness entry gate.
specification.output: FinishingTravelerManifest with validated chemistry parameters, step-by-step operator sign-off checklist, and mandatory eddy-current verification gate.

evening_dispatched_pbis.acceptance_criteria_gherkin:
Given a batch of 35 CNC-milled enclosures routed for black sulfuric anodizing
When Chukwudi opens the digital traveler
Then it verifies substrate alloy as certified 6061-T6 (Silicon < 0.4%)
And prescribes tank temperature at 18°C, current density at 1.5 A/dm², and 45-minute immersion
And mandates an eddy-current coating thickness entry before shipment.

evening_dispatched_pbis.title: [US-C-04] Mandatory Heat-Treatment Pyrometer Log Enforcement (Negative / Exception)

specification.user_story: As a Quality Inspector, I want the system to require continuous pyrometer soak temperature logs for quench-and-temper heat treatments so that unverified or under-soaked parts are intercepted before dispatch.
specification.input: Batch traveler ID, heat treatment specification (e.g. 4140 oil quench at 845°C, 60-min soak, temper at 540°C), furnace thermocouple/pyrometer time-series log.
specification.action: Validate pyrometer readings against required soak temperature tolerance window (±10°C) and minimum duration; detect thermal drops or missing telemetry; flag under-soaked batches.
specification.output: HeatTreatmentAuditResult: 'CERTIFIED' if soak verified, 'QUARANTINE_UNDER_SOAKED' if temperature dropped > 15°C; blocks batch authorization if uncertified.

evening_dispatched_pbis.acceptance_criteria_gherkin:
Given a batch of 20 AISI 4140 drive shafts requiring 845°C austenitizing for 60 minutes
When the furnace pyrometer log indicates a temperature drop to 790°C at minute 38 for 12 minutes
Then the system flags a 'THERMAL_SOAK_VIOLATION: Under-temperature excursion detected'
And locks the batch status to 'QUARANTINE_HEAT_TREAT_DEFICIT'
And notifies the applications engineer and prevents dispatch.

evening_dispatched_pbis.title: [US-X-03] Measuring Tool Calibration Registry Check

specification.user_story: As a Quality Inspector / Machinist, I want the system to check measuring tool calibration dates before accepting dimensional readings so that defective or expired tools cannot certify production parts.
specification.input: Measuring tool identifier (tool serial ID, e.g. digital micrometer MIC-2041), inspection entry payload, operator ID.
specification.action: Query CalibrationRegistry for tool serial ID; check annual calibration expiration timestamp against current system date; evaluate calibration currency.
specification.output: ValidationResult: if valid -> permit submission; if expired -> block submission, display alert message with hub recalibration link, require entry of certified tool ID.

evening_dispatched_pbis.acceptance_criteria_gherkin:
Given a digital micrometer with an annual calibration stamp that expired 14 days ago
When Sunday enters the tool ID to log first-article journal readings
Then the app blocks submission
And displays: 'TOOL CALIBRATION EXPIRED: Use certified tool or schedule hub recalibration'
And requires entry of an accredited tool serial number to proceed.
